Reviews.review_text: I visited Mao Family Restaurant for dinner, and it was excellent! The service was great; my food arrived in just 10-20 minutes. The cuisine was very authentic and delicious. I loved the live music, too! There was a little wait for a table, about 10-20 minutes, but it was worth it. They also have valet parking. I will come back again!

Mao Family Restaurant exceeded my expectations with its delightful blend of flavors and generous portions. The warm ambiance and attentive service created a welcoming atmosphere. Every dish was crafted with care, showcasing authentic cuisine that felt both comforting and innovative. With reasonable prices for the quality, it`s truly worth every penny! Highly recommend!

Mao Family Restaurant is truly a gem! The freshness of their food is unmatched; you can taste the quality in every bite. From flavorful curries to perfectly cooked rice, each dish reflects their commitment to authentic flavors. The ambiance is warm and inviting, making it a perfect spot for family gatherings or casual dining. Highly recommend it for anyone seeking delicious and fresh Indian cuisine!

I recently dined at Mao Family Restaurant, and I must say it was a disappointing experience. The food tasted mediocre at best, lacking any real flavor or creativity. Service was slow, and the ambiance felt dull and uninspired. For a family outing, I expected more. If you`re looking for a memorable meal, I`d recommend looking elsewhere. Save your time and money; this restaurant simply doesn`t deliver on its promises.

Mao Family Restaurant is excellent! The staff is very friendly and trained well. They know the menu and help you pick the best dishes. Service is fast, and they always smile. I felt welcome and happy during my meal. The staff makes a big difference here! I will come back soon to enjoy more great food with their wonderful service.

Mao Family Restaurant is great! Booking a table is very easy. You can call or use their website. The staff is friendly and helps quickly. I booked a table for my family, and it was simple. We had no wait when we arrived. I love how fast and nice it was! If you want to eat good food without stress, go to Mao Family Restaurant! Highly recommend!

I visited Mao Family Restaurant. It is a nice place to eat. The restaurant is child-friendly, which means kids can enjoy their time there. The food portions are good, so you get a lot for your money. The atmosphere is friendly and warm. Overall, I had a great experience at Mao Family Restaurant!

I had a great experience at Mao Family Restaurant. The food was very good, and there was a lot to choose from. The staff were friendly and helpful. I enjoyed my meal and felt happy with the service. The restaurant was clean and nice. I would love to visit again!

Mao Family Restaurant offers a delightful dining experience with exceptional service that stands out. The staff is attentive and friendly, ensuring that every visit feels special. The menu features a variety of dishes, each bursting with flavor. Whether you`re craving classic favorites or trying something new, Mao`s has you covered. The cozy ambiance adds to the overall charm, making it a great spot for family gatherings or casual meals. Highly recommend!

Mao Family Restaurant has very stale food. The bread was hard and old. The vegetables looked bad and tasted funny. I did not enjoy my meal at all. The service was slow, too. I felt disappointed and unhappy after eating there. I do not recommend this restaurant for anyone who wants fresh food. It is a big letdown!
